description: ValiCert Security Module 1.0 is the name of the module that will contain DES, TDES, and SHA-1 algorithms. The module will be included in a variety of ValiCert products, e.g. ValiCert Validation Authority (VA), ValiCert Transaction Authority (TA), and ValiCert Secure Transport (ST).
